mapper.select: SELECT userID AS userId, videoID AS videoId, SUM(weight) AS score FROM ( SELECT userID, videoID, 1.0 AS weight FROM history WHERE enable = 1 UNION ALL SELECT userID, videoID, CASE WHEN typeEnable = 1 THEN 3.0 ELSE -3.0 END AS weight FROM likes WHERE enable = 1 UNION ALL SELECT userID, videoID, 5.0 AS weight FROM favorite WHERE enable = 1 ) AS combined GROUP BY userID, videoID LIMIT #{limit}
